verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents server-side session control. Administrators can manage user sessions [keycloak-docs-21] and users can manage their own sessions [keycloak-docs-48]. A token revocation endpoint covers both access and refresh tokens [keycloak-docs-53], introspection checks whether a token is still active [keycloak-docs-52], and single sign-out logs a user out of all applications [keycloak-docs-15]. missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable session/token expiry timeouts, explicit detail of the refresh-token flow, documented admin-initiated kill of a specific session, and independent hands-on corroboration of immediate revocation.
